lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately 1.5x wider in the mid-section compared to the anterior cluster.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the dorsal apex of the second vertical line from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 10, 11, and 12 exhibit vertical fragmentation, terminating mid-flank and transitioning into the posterior spot pattern.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of approximately 15 circular spots located on the posterior haunch and lateral hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 4 spots is visible below the terminal ends of the 8th and 9th vertical lines.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the facial and cervical regions by high-contrast white acacia thorns; white facial chevron and sub-ocular spot visible between occluding elements.
